bank_plan.formula: (lesson_check_items + module_check_items) x 2 alternates + forms x form_length
bank_plan.eighty_twenty_note: 80% instruction / 20% assessment honoured at course level (I+A=T); bank serves lesson checks, module checks, 3 practice forms and a protected final.
bank_plan.size_band_note: Planning range per assessment standard (200-600 skills; 600-1500+ large certification). This is a planning guide, not proof of quality.

mcq_limitation_note: Official test assesses writing and speaking; MCQ/MR cannot assess productive skills. Mastemy teaches all four skills by video and model-answer analysis but scores only receptive and knowledge items.

items.stem: A GT Writing Task 1 asks the candidate to write to a manager they have never met to request leave. Which tone is appropriate?

options.rationale: Correct: writing to an unknown senior person for an official request calls for a formal tone.
Informal tone is inappropriate for an unknown manager and an official request.
Slang is never appropriate in a formal request letter.
Omitting greeting and sign-off breaks letter conventions and lowers the band.

items.explanation: An official request to an unknown senior reader requires a formal register.
items.provenance: AI-drafted original item, not from any proprietary, leaked or paid exam source

items.stem: A GT Reading statement reads 'The office is open on Sundays.' The notice lists Monday to Saturday hours and says nothing about Sunday. The claim is:

options.rationale: Correct: listing Mon-Sat opening hours and no Sunday entry contradicts 'open on Sundays'.
The schedule implicitly excludes Sunday, so the claim is contradicted, not merely absent.
No Sunday hours are listed, so the claim is not supported.
IELTS offers only True, False or Not Given.

items.explanation: A complete Mon-Sat schedule with no Sunday hours contradicts a Sunday-open claim.

items.stem: Which TWO features most improve a GT Task 1 letter's 'Task Achievement' band?

options.text: Covering all bullet points in the prompt
options.rationale: Correct: addressing every bullet is core to task achievement.

options.text: Maintaining a consistent, appropriate tone throughout
options.rationale: Correct: consistent register is part of achieving the letter's purpose.

options.text: Adding unrelated personal anecdotes to lengthen it
options.rationale: Off-task content does not improve task achievement.

options.text: Writing far below the minimum word count
Leaving out the purpose of the letter
options.rationale: Omitting the purpose directly harms task achievement.

items.explanation: Task achievement depends on covering all bullets and keeping an appropriate tone.
